prompt: Low angle up a 1960s council tower block at dusk: every window on every floor boarded with grey steel sheets except one, where a single lamp still glows, and at its foot on the grass a camp of tents and furniture where the tenants now live. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
